label: Co-Worker
notes: No embedder slot on purpose: the brief is synthesised from whole items, not retrieved chunks, so there is nothing to embed.

The only rail with no database and no corpus. Its input is a directory of JSON files written by an external harvest process on the Windows host and bind-mounted in; the contract for those files is SCHEMA.md, which is a separate contract from this manifest.
CO_WORKER_PROMPTS_DIR and the read-only /data/prompts mount are wired ahead of the API that will serve them (commit 6a27eab). Deliberate groundwork, not dead config.
